system.summary: Homophonic substitution (1-2 signs per letter), three nulls, an et sign, and a ~300-number code set off by dots with an alphabetical addendum above 300; key published by Tomokiyo.
system.notes: Partly-enciphered letters: clear text with enciphered passages.

prior_solution.where: Tomokiyo, cryptiana savoy.htm (2017, rev. 2023): reconstructed key table and images of these three letters, stating many code groups undeciphered; no reading of nos. 11, 62, 100 there or in print. Contemporary decipherments exist only for siblings (fr. 3983 no. 80, fr. 3984 f.182, fr. 3985 f.23).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: set up Claude Code with Opus 5 and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Tomokiyo's league.htm lists four Lebel letters and points to savoy.htm with a reconstructed key table (src/savoy.png).
Fetched fr. 3983 canvases 49-50, 233-234, 333-335 and the no. 80 leaves 293-295 from Gallica IIIF (fetch.py).
First pass on no. 11 with Tomokiyo's key: reading11.md, many code groups open.
Misjudged Tomokiyo's image downloads as overlaid decipherments and closed the target as already read; re-checked savoy.htm: he states the three letters are not read, only keyed.
Sign-by-sign band transcription of nos. 11, 62, 100 from crops (zb.py, zc.py).
Letter-sign corrections to the table: nabla=y, crossed delta=d and i, X=i in remedie, o-arrow=h, long h=n/l, alpha=z, barred T=b, bm/vm=d.
Harvested code values from contemporary decipherments of fr. 3983 no. 80 (f.167), fr. 3984 f.182 and fr. 3985 f.23 (codes_harvest.tsv): 12 glossed, 14 aligned.
Second pass: no. 11 ~93%, no. 62 recto ~94% / verso ~55%, no. 100 ~85% of letter signs; ~28 code numbers open.
Readings consistent with the 1593 Estates: Mayenne's council Villeroy/Jeannin, Feria, Tassis, Zamet, Pelvé, siege of Noyon in clear text.

Second code harvest: fr. 3984 f. 182r-v re-read closely (about 40 more code values, 85 Monsieur, 64 le, 113 celuy corrected from 115) and BnF esp. 336 nos. 79-81 located (ark btv1b100325613); only no. 81 is glossed. 26 codes in the three letters appear in no glossed source.

f. 130v (no. 62) bleed-through removed by registering the mirrored native-resolution recto patch by patch and whitening bleed-level pixels; the three cipher lines went from about 55% to about 62% of signs, confirming 221 mariage and reading 'niece du duc de Florance'.
Context reading of the unglossed BnF esp. 336 nos. 79-80 (ark btv1b100325613, canvases 268-273) with the corrected key: 283 lettres, 163 prince(s), 227 seigneur(s) given C values (reading_esp336.md).
Third pass on no. 11 (reading11_final.md): all harvested values re-applied, 64.280.50 and 250 re-read at native resolution; 58/58 code tokens valued (41 H, 11 C, 6 M), ~714/720 letter signs.
Third pass on no. 62 (reading62_final.md): recto 607/617 tokens valued (98%), 62/62 codes; verso blot shown to be one sign, ~70/101 tokens; 223, 247 open.
Third pass on no. 100 (reading100_final.md): 103 venir, 257 faveur(s), 142 serviteur, 115 bon by agreeing contexts; all 1000 enciphered tokens valued (codes 65 H, 26 C, 19 M).

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): nos. 11, 62, 100: sign-by-sign transcriptions reading*_full.md, decryptions reading*_final.md; key: Tomokiyo's src/savoy.png, codes_harvest.tsv, and the NOTES key corrections copied to texts/key.md.

v3 verification: no. 62 scored 0.518 on reading62_final.md (code notation). Running text with only glossed/confirmed codes resolved (no62_reading.md, research/reading_audit/v3a_lebel.py): 0.621 explicit-hole, plain 0.414. Keeps read, marginal.

outcome.method_basis: Tomokiyo's key table for the Lebel-Savoy correspondence (cryptiana savoy.htm, reconstructed from fr. 3983 no. 80 and fr. 3984/3985 decipherments) was applied to nos. 11, 62, 100, which he had not read; letter signs were corrected and about 40 code values harvested from the glossed sibling letters of the same series.
outcome.notes: Final pass 21 Sept 2026: no. 11 ~714/720 letter signs, 58/58 codes (41 H, 11 C, 6 M); no. 62 recto 607/617 tokens (98%), 62/62 codes (36 H, 13 C, 13 M), verso ~70/101; no. 100 1000/1000 tokens (codes 65 H, 26 C, 19 M). Overall ~97% of enciphered tokens valued.

texts.label: no. 11, Paris, 17 January 1593 (f. 26r-v)
texts.summary: Lebel reports to Charles Emmanuel I that Mayenne is again thinking of claiming the crown, encouraged by letters from Rome; the Pope and the King of Spain want a Catholic king elected, Mayenne will favour whichever candidate brings him most advantage, and his secret council is the archbishop of Lyon (Épinac), Villeroy and président Jeannin.

texts.label: no. 62, Paris, 10 March 1593 (f. 130r-v)
texts.summary: Mayenne's discontent has been bought off with 40,000 écus down and assignations up to 260,000 écus; Feria brings a doctor who wants to dispute the crown on points of law, which is openly mocked; the Spanish army is smaller than any before it, those around Mayenne will propose a truce, and Lebel advises courting Mayenne.

reading_review.note: v3 verification 23 Oct 2026: reading62_final.md scored 0.518 with its [code value, grade] notation (each code giving a bare number and a grade letter as holes) and its counts/notes sections. Written out in no62_reading.md (H/C codes as {value}, M/forced/open codes and alternatives as [?value]): 0.621 explicit-hole (18/29 sentences, hole rate 0.13), plain 0.414 (1593 spelling). f. 130r holds; the few lines of f. 130v legible past the recto ink are fragments. Marginal.

texts.label: no. 100, Paris, 27 March 1593 (ff. 194r-195r)
texts.summary: If Philip II's designs for the Infanta fail, Savoy could with more reason than any other prince hope for the crown from the Estates; money for his 'compagnon' and président Jeannin, paid through Zamet, Feria's and Commandeur Tassis's letters, good offices with the Pope, the Provence governorship, Vaudemont and the château of Miolans. With nos. 11 and 62 it follows Savoy's candidacy at the Estates of the League, January to March 1593.
